title: Tripartite Zarankiewicz numbers and norm graphs
summary: For fixed integers $s\ge t\ge2$, let $\operatorname{ex}(n,n,n,K_{s,t})$ denote the maximum number of edges in a tripartite $K_{s,t}$-free graph with $n$ vertices in each part. When $s\ge(t-1)!+1$, let $r$ be the largest integer satisfying $s\ge(t-1)!r^{t-1}+1$.
